items.title: Why higher yields aren't scaring off retail traders

items.summary: A semiconductor sell-off hit Micron hard, but investors shouldn't be too nervous.

items.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock May Be Reasonable After Fresh AI Storage News
items.summary: Western Digital stock has delivered an exceptionally strong run over the past three years, yet the current valuation checks still lean toward the shares looking inexpensive on several measures. After such a sharp move higher, investors are weighing whether that apparent discount is still meaningful or already reflects the optimism in the story. items.title: This Stock Could Be a Major AI Winner Through 2027. What’s It Worth?
items.summary: Micron has turned memory into one of the purest AI plays on the market, with revenues exploding and $100 billion in locked-in contracts, but whether the stock still has room to run or has already priced in the boom is a question worth answering before the next move.

items.title: Micron Technology Stock Has Become A Bet On Memory Prices
items.summary: Micron's record revenue arrived on shipments that barely grew, which leaves the price of memory carrying the entire case.

items.title: Memory Stocks Struggle for Momentum With ‘Smart Money’ Moving On
items.summary: After ripping through the first half of the year, memory stocks are struggling to regain momentum as growing concerns about the state of the artificial intelligence trade overshadow their strong fundamental backdrop.

items.title: SK Hynix Climbs 4% on Record Buyback, Micron Ticks Up as Memory Defies the Tech Selloff
items.summary: While the rest of the tech sector bleeds red Thursday, memory stocks are defying gravity, and the catalyst powering the biggest winner has nothing to do with AI chips.

items.title: Seagate Has Already Surged 900% in 5 Years. Where Will it be In 2027?
items.summary: Seagate defied every prediction that solid-state storage would kill the hard drive, and cloud AI demand has since sent shares on a historic run. Whether that momentum carries into 2027 depends on factors most investors are not yet watching closely.
